channel.title: MLAIA Blog — AI & Data Science Insights
channel.description: Technical insights on audio and signal processing, medical AI, and forecasting and causal analysis from the MLAIA team.

item.title: Music AI in 2026: Generation, Separation, and the Copyright Minefield
item.dc:creator: Dr. Yochai Edlitz
item.description: A production engineer's guide to music AI in 2026: how Suno, Udio and MusicGen generate music, Demucs stem separation, and the RIAA copyright lawsuits.

item.title: Time Series in Production: From Prophet to Foundation Models — and When Survival Analysis Is What You Actually Need
item.dc:creator: Dr. Yochai Edlitz
item.description: ARIMA, Prophet, TimesFM, Amazon Chronos, MOIRAI, TFT, N-BEATS — and when to reach for Kaplan-Meier or DeepSurv instead. A production engineer's guide to time series forecasting and survival analysis in 2026.

item.title: Tabular Data in 2026: Do Gradient-Boosted Trees Still Beat Deep Learning?
item.dc:creator: Dr. Yochai Edlitz
item.description: TabNet, FT-Transformer and TabPFN vs XGBoost, LightGBM and CatBoost: 2026 benchmarks, production tradeoffs, and when deep learning finally wins.

item.title: Computer Vision in Production: From Tracking to VLMs to Edge Deployment
item.dc:creator: Dr. Yochai Edlitz
item.description: A practitioner's guide to deploying computer vision in production: multi-object tracking (ByteTrack, DeepSORT), optical flow with RAFT, Vision Language Models (GPT-4V, LLaVA), sensor fusion, and edge AI on Hailo, Jetson, and smartphone NPUs.

item.title: Clinical AI That Ships: From FDA Clearance to the Bedside
item.dc:creator: Dr. Yochai Edlitz
item.description: How production clinical AI actually gets from FDA clearance to bedside deployment: shadow mode validation, drift detection, bias auditing, and the $6.5B Israeli digital health market — a practitioner's guide.

item.title: Measuring Ads Without the Cookie: MMM, Incrementality & Causal Marketing Science in 2026
item.dc:creator: Dr. Yochai Edlitz
item.description: Signal loss has erased 30–40% of trackable conversions. Inside the 2026 measurement stack: Bayesian Marketing Mix Modeling, incrementality testing, and the triangulation framework — a data science guide from MLAIA.

item.title: Forecasting Spare-Parts Demand: Why Min/Max Rules Fail on Intermittent, Lumpy Movers
item.dc:creator: Dr. Yochai Edlitz
item.description: Spreadsheets and ERP min/max rules break down on intermittent, lumpy spare-parts demand. A practical look at the statistical methods (Croston's method, SBA, TSB, ADI/CV² classification, demand bootstrapping) and machine-learning techniques that produce reliable reorder points, safety stock, and projected stockout dates — and free capital frozen in dead stock. Built into NextDemand, MLAIA's spare-parts demand-forecasting product.

item.title: Your MLOps Vendor Just Got Acquired — Now What?
item.dc:creator: Dr. Yochai Edlitz
item.description: The MLOps vendor consolidation wave is reshaping the market. Iguazio, Dataloop, Neptune.ai, Seldon — what happens to your ML platform when your vendor gets acquired or shuts down, and what to do next.

item.title: Audio AI in Production: From Speech Models to Sound Intelligence
item.dc:creator: Dr. Yochai Edlitz
item.description: Speech-to-text, voice synthesis, sound event detection, music generation, and real-time edge deployment — what works in production audio AI, what doesn't, and what it costs in 2026.

item.title: AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Azure AI: How Cloud Platforms Are Accelerating ML R&D
item.dc:creator: Dr. Yochai Edlitz
item.description: How the three major cloud ML platforms are compressing research-to-production timelines — and what enterprise teams should know when choosing between them.

item.title: The State of AI in Israeli Industry: Trends and Opportunities in 2026
item.dc:creator: Dr. Yochai Edlitz
item.description: A research-style overview of AI adoption across Israel's key sectors — healthcare, defense, audio tech, ad tech, and finance — and what companies need from specialized AI consulting partners.

item.title: Wait, The World's Fastest AI Supercomputers Run on Something Called "Slurm"?
item.dc:creator: Dr. Yochai Edlitz
item.description: A deep dive into Slurm — the Simple Linux Utility for Resource Management — the job scheduler powering the world's most advanced AI compute clusters including those at OpenAI, Meta, Google, and leading national labs.

item.title: Transforming Sales with AI: A Success Story with Israel's Leading Communication Company
item.dc:creator: Dr. Yochai Edlitz
item.description: How MLAIA applied machine learning across the full sales pipeline for Israel's leading telecom company — from lead scoring and churn prediction to AI-assisted call center optimization — driving measurable ROI.

item.title: Supercharging Machine Learning Models with Classical Digital Signal Processing
item.dc:creator: Dr. Yochai Edlitz
item.description: Why combining classical DSP (Fourier transforms, digital filters, wavelets) with modern deep learning produces superior real-time signal intelligence. Practical hybrid DSP-ML architectures applied to industrial, defense, and healthcare sensor data.

item.title: Unleashing the Power of Graphs for Machine Learning
item.dc:creator: Dr. Yochai Edlitz
item.description: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are transforming machine learning across social network analysis, bioinformatics, fraud detection, and drug discovery. An exploration of how graph-based models reveal structure in complex, interconnected data.

item.title: Expertise Without Boundaries: Affordable AI and ML Development
item.dc:creator: Dr. Yochai Edlitz
item.description: How the outsourced AI consulting model delivers senior ML expertise to startups and enterprises without the cost and timeline of full-time hiring. Why MLAIA's approach enables faster iteration, lower overhead, and access to PhD-level talent on demand.
